Кнопка подготавливает доступ к модему че: This action prepares modem access through stock Web, USB ADB and then SSH. On verified B31 it may restore a modified settings backup to enable ADB, then install the agent with a separate SSH service. Opening this help does not start any operation.

2. Вход в Web и свежий архив настроек: 2. Web login and a fresh settings archive
Windows-приложение запрашивает challenge: The Windows application requests zte_web_sault and submits the password hash with the challenge to stock web_login. It reads IMEI and firmware versions, requests a fresh encrypted settings backup and downloads back_parameter. The original archive is saved locally with its hash. File sizes, contents and modem identity are checked before any change.
3. Проверка архива и подготовка ADB на B: 3. Archive validation and ADB preparation on B31
Архив расшифровывается в памяти ключом и: The archive is decrypted in memory using a key derived from the IMEI and the built-in suffix. The OpenSSL Salted__ header, nested gzip/tar structures, inner archive MD5, filenames and metadata are checked. If ADB is disabled, only the intended ADB setting is changed; the archive is repacked and checked again. The original archive remains available locally.
На B31 приложение сверяет Web-устройство: On B31, Web identity is checked before uploading and before restoring the modified archive. The stock CGI must return the SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes. Before device_restore_proc, setup-pending.json records restore-requested. Restore reboots the modem. An interrupted HTTP request is not retried blindly: the application waits up to four minutes for verified USB ADB. This Web ADB-enabling path is not used on experimental B02, which must already provide root USB ADB.
5. Выбор USB-устройства и проверка профи: 5. USB selection and firmware profile verification
Встроенный adb.exe перечисляет USB-устро: The bundled adb.exe enumerates USB devices. Each candidate is checked for root, aarch64, modem.b16 and diag-router SHA-256, eMMC CID, boot_id and stock Web identity. IMEI and firmware versions must match the downloaded Web backup. Multiple matches stop installation. Verified MU5250 B31 is allowed by default. Skipping the general firmware check only permits the known experimental B02 profile with existing root USB ADB; the installer still requires exact known hashes. B02 preparation permits access and reading IMEI, not writing NV.
Перед установкой проверяются SHA-256 вст: The bundled agent, Dropbear and script hashes, CID, free space, directory types and permissions are verified first. /data/local and /data/local/tmp are created if necessary. adb push transfers the agent, Dropbear, installer, startup scripts and public SSH key into a private /data/local/tmp/zte-imei-setup-<UUID> directory. Incoming files are checked by SHA-256 before promotion. Before persistent changes, the installer saves the original files and hashes in /data/local/tmp/zte-imei-installations/<UUID>.
Если агента ещё нет, он размещается в /d: If the agent is missing, it is placed at /data/zte-agent with its root startup script and agent password in /data/local/tmp/start_zte_agent.sh. An existing agent and password are preserved. Dropbear and dropbearkey are installed under /data/bin if needed; the application public key is added to /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys without removing other keys. Server keys remain in /etc/dropbear, with copies and authorized_keys in /data/dropbear. /etc/rc.local starts /data/local/tmp/start_zte_imei_studio.sh to launch a missing agent and a separate key-authenticated SSH listener on port 2222. Original modified files are journaled first.
Встроенный ssh-keygen.exe создаёт или по: Bundled ssh-keygen.exe creates or reuses the local Ed25519 key pair. The private key remains in %LOCALAPPDATA% with restricted Windows ACLs; only the public key goes to the modem. The server Ed25519 host key is read through verified ADB, after another identity check, and pinned in a dedicated known_hosts file. SSH.NET compares server keys byte for byte and does not automatically accept replacements. ADB and SSH identity, the agent process and new-agent password login are verified. B31 also reads both NV slots and compares them with the API; B02 does not write NV. Only then is the installer committed.
Локальный setup-pending.json хранит стад: setup-pending.json stores the stage and device identity. A previously submitted Web restore is never repeated automatically. If the installer may have reached the device, its remote journal is checked; automatic completion requires a confirmed ready or complete state. The original archive remains in SetupBackups/<UUID>, installation.log is saved after the installer responds, and setup-result.json is saved on success. The temporary local password file is deleted after transfer. Preparation does not change IMEIs, install Launcher or modem localization, or write the raw ZTEDATA partition.
Подробно о записи обоих IMEI: Detailed steps for writing both IMEIs
Кнопка меняет два индекса NV550 через пр: This action changes two NV550 slots through verified DIAG/EFS helpers. Original NV and EFS config are backed up on Windows before any write. Writing is temporarily enabled, and the result is verified after two reboots. This workflow is only for verified MU5250 B31; experimental B02 remains read-only for IMEI.
Запись запускается только после подключе: Writing requires an existing root SSH connection; this button does not prepare the modem. SSH.NET uses the local Ed25519 private key and the exact host key pinned in known_hosts during preparation. Both IMEIs must contain 15 digits, have valid check digits and differ. Exact MU5250 B31 firmware and diag-router SHA-256 values are rechecked before writing; skipping the general firmware check does not remove this requirement. Pending preparation or IMEI operations block a new write.
Приложение сверяет eMMC CID, хэши прошив: The application checks eMMC CID, firmware hashes and boot_id. It acquires the local imei-operation.lock, records a token in imei-lock.json and creates the operation-owned /tmp/zte-imei-app.lock on the modem. zte_nv reads both 128-byte NV550 slots; their IMEIs are compared with the stock get_imei and get_imei2 ubus API. If the target pair is already present, the operation does not start.
Перед каждым вызовом встроенные zte_nv,: Before each call, bundled zte_nv, zte_config and zte_config_read are checked against Resources/Helpers/helpers.json. A helper is sent through SSH stdin into a private /tmp/zte-imei-<UUID> directory, given mode 700 and checked again by SHA-256. Any required plan is transferred and verified separately. Afterwards, the application attempts to remove only its own temporary directory. These DIAG/EFS helpers accept specific verified modes rather than arbitrary write commands.
zte_config_read читает /config внутри EF: zte_config_read reads /config inside the modem processor EFS, not the Linux /config file. B31 structure is checked: 15,073 bytes, 249 records, CRC and the original write flag. Both NV slots are read again to detect changes during backup. Backups/IMEI/<UUID> contains nv0.bin, nv1.bin, config.bin and manifest.json with hashes, IMEIs and identity; the application immediately reopens and validates it. Only then is imei-pending.json created with complete target NV values. Only the first 9 IMEI-encoding bytes of each 128-byte NV change; the remaining 119 bytes are preserved. This is not a full modem image.
5. Временный флаг и первая перезагрузка: 5. Temporary write flag and first reboot
Из исходного config формируется кандидат: A candidate config changes config102 at offset 499 from 0 to 1 and recalculates the CRC; all other bytes are preserved. zte_config receives the original/candidate plan, enables writing using verified EFS operations, and config is reread. Stage and time are saved before any potentially ambiguous call. The stock reboot command is sent once; the application waits up to four minutes for the same modem with a new boot_id. Losing SSH during reboot does not by itself mean failure.
6. Два индекса NV550 последовательно: 6. Write the two NV550 slots in sequence
После загрузки проверяются config и оба: After boot, config and both NV slots must match a known original or target state. A 512-byte plan combines current NV0/NV1 and target NV0/NV1. zte_nv --apply-plan writes slots 0 and 1 in sequence and verifies each step. The application then rereads both NV slots and both ubus values. Writing both slots is not atomic. The helper may attempt to restore known originals on failure, but power or connection loss requires checking the actual result.
7. Возврат config и заключительная прове: 7. Restore config and verify the result
После подтверждения пары zte_config возв: After confirming both IMEIs, zte_config restores the exact original EFS config, including its flag and CRC. The application records final-reboot, requests the second reboot once and waits for a new boot_id on the same modem. NV, API and byte-for-byte original config are then checked. IMEIResults/<UUID>.json is created and imei-pending.json removed only after complete success. A new operation normally uses two reboots; resume determines completed steps from the journal and actual device state.
8. Продолжение и восстановление пары: 8. Resume and restore the IMEI pair
Если операция прервалась, бэкап и imei-p: If interrupted, the backup and imei-pending.json remain. Resume interrupted operation rechecks identity, backup hashes, current NV and config; unknown states stop automatic writing. An ambiguous config call requires at least a 210-second delay, and an NV write a 150-second delay, before another check. Restore in the backup list uses the same guarded workflow and first makes a fresh backup; the unrelated 119 bytes of both NV slots must match the selected backup. This workflow neither writes raw partitions nor replaces a full ZTEDATA image.

2. Если SSH или ADB уже работает: 2. If SSH or ADB is already working
Сначала проверяется существующая установ:
The existing SSH and agent installation is checked first. Success requires a trusted host key, root access and matching modem identity. Once readiness is confirmed, preparation finishes without enabling ADB again or reinstalling the existing agent. Resuming an earlier installation also requires checking its journal.

If SSH is not ready, the bundled adb runs devices -l. Device, offline, unauthorized and permission states are distinguished. When the usb: descriptor is absent, as can happen on Windows, adb -d get-serialno must identify the same single USB device. Network ADB and emulators are not treated as USB modems. Commands through adb -s <serial> shell then verify root, ARM64, CID, firmware hashes and stock Web identity. The modem must match the intended target.

When ADB is ready, all activation methods are skipped. The application checks the installer profile and continues with SSH/agent installation. An absent usb: field or unavailable SSH alone does not cause a backup restore.
Для ранних прошивок сначала включите гал:
For earlier firmware, first enable Skip firmware check: normal preparation is verified for B31. This option does not authorize installing components on unsupported firmware. When no matching ADB device is found, the application queries zwrt_bsp.usb methods through JSON-RPC list. The stock method is eligible when set declares a mode parameter. If introspection itself is unavailable, one fallback attempt is allowed only for the historically known CN MU5250 family through B27. An explicit method list without set skips this method. A similar-looking firmware name does not authorize the B31 restore path on unknown firmware.

The Web identity is checked again and intent is saved in setup-pending.json before sending zwrt_bsp.usb.set {"mode":"debug"} exactly once. Switching USB composition may disconnect USB networking; using the modem Wi-Fi can keep Web reachable. This method itself neither uploads a backup nor requests a reboot.

Accepted, rejected and unconfirmed replies are logged separately. For up to 90 seconds, the application checks for actual root USB ADB on the same modem; RPC status 0 alone is not readiness. An interrupted request is not automatically sent again. If ADB does not appear, only B31 can proceed to restore, after logging into Web again, verifying the same device and taking a new backup. If Web does not return, preparation stops.
4. B31: включение через бэкап и перезагр: 4. B31: enabling ADB through backup and reboot
Этот способ применяется только к провере:
This path is restricted to the verified MU5250 B31 profile when working ADB has not been confirmed. A fresh archive is decrypted in memory using the IMEI and backup-key suffix. OpenSSL Salted__, nested gzip/tar files, MD5, member names and metadata are checked. Only the line below is added immediately after #!/bin/sh in etc/rc.local. Other entries are preserved and compared with the original. The result is repacked, encrypted and decrypted again for verification.

Before upload, back_parameter.adb-only is saved and the Web device is checked again. The CGI uploader must confirm the SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes. Identity is checked once more, restore-requested is persisted, and device_restore_proc is called once. The modem restores settings and reboots, interrupting connectivity. The application waits up to four minutes for USB ADB and verifies root and identity. An accepted restore request alone does not complete preparation.

If the original rc.local already contains the line, the backup is not restored again: actual ADB access is checked and its absence explained. An adbd process can run while USB remains in normal networking mode; the process alone is insufficient. A lost restore reply never triggers another automatic restore. Resume uses the saved journal and device checks; an installer that may already have run is not blindly started again either.
«Не обнаружен»: проверьте USB-кабель дан:
Not detected: check the USB data cable and port; on Windows, also check the Android ADB driver in Device Manager. A charging-only cable is insufficient. Unauthorized: the device is visible but has not granted debugging access; confirm a prompt on the modem if one is shown. Offline: a transport exists but shell is not responding; reconnect the cable and check again. Missing permissions, failure to start local adb and remote command failures are reported separately. The application does not install drivers or disable driver signature enforcement.

If USB ADB sees a device but root, architecture or the intended modem identity cannot be confirmed, a successful connection is not reported and diagnostics retain the reason. All these checks must pass before the installer is transferred. When multiple matching devices are connected, the first serial is not selected arbitrarily. Installation requires matching IMEI/versions and CID. Each shell call must return a separate remote exit marker: local adb exit code 0 cannot hide a failed modem command.

ADB access and installer compatibility are checked separately. SSH/agent installation supports exact B31 and experimental B02 hashes. The stock method may enable ADB on earlier firmware, but unsupported installation stops with a message about unsupported firmware or diag-router. Skipping the general firmware check does not remove installer restrictions. B31 restore is not used for B02 or unknown firmware. Factory passwords, fac_open and hidden factory methods are not tried automatically.
